title: Chatbot LLD
subtitle: Follow steps 1–10 top to bottom for one chat message. Middle column: where data lives. Right: the MCP endpoint and re-indexing. Click any box for details. Generated from the Worker code.

data.label: 1. Chat widget
data.description: You type a question. The useChat hook POSTs { message, pagePath } to the Worker and shows the answer as it streams back (events: response = append text, replace = swap text, sources = links).

data.label: 2. Input guardrails
data.description: Rejects empty or > 500-char messages, off-limits topics (whole words only) and prompt-extraction attempts. Rejected → fixed reply, no AI call.

data.label: 3. Rate limiter
data.description: At most 20 messages per 60s per IP (Cloudflare Rate Limiting binding).

data.label: 4. Session
data.description: Reads the chatbot_session cookie and loads the conversation from KV (last 40 turns, 7 days). Malformed ids are ignored.

data.label: 5. Retrieval (RAG)
data.description: Turns the question into an embedding and fetches the 5 most similar chunks from Vectorize (similarity ≥ 0.65).

data.label: 6. Scope gate
data.description: Is this about Dival? Yes if it uses portfolio words, is a greeting or follow-up, or matched the index strongly (≥ 0.72). No → polite refusal, no AI call.

data.label: 7. Prompt builder
data.description: Rules + a site index (all post/project titles from the KV catalog) + the retrieved chunks + the last 10 turns.

data.label: 8. LLM (streaming)
data.description: @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast generates the answer token by token.

data.label: 9. Output guard
data.description: Forwards each token to the browser as it arrives, hides the internal contact token, and swaps the reply if it starts leaking instructions.

data.label: 10. Contact tool
data.description: Only when the user asked to message Dival and confirmed: validates name/email/message and sends it (max 3 per chat).

data.label: /api/contact
data.description: Next.js route shared with the site's contact form.

data.label: Workers KV
data.description: Chat sessions, the seed manifest (chunk id → hash) and the catalog (titles/links of posts, projects, roles, skills).

data.label: Vectorize
data.description: Index "faq-vectors": one vector per chunk of profile, experience, project, skills and blog text.

data.label: MCP client
data.description: An external AI agent (Claude Desktop, an IDE) connected to the Worker's /mcp URL.

data.label: MCP server (/mcp)
data.description: Read-only tools: search_portfolio (same vector index), get_profile and list_blog_posts (KV catalog). Cannot send messages.

data.label: Re-indexer
data.description: Runs on deploy, on Contentful publish and daily (0 3 * * *). Re-embeds only chunks whose content changed.

data.label: /api/chat-context
data.description: Next.js route returning profile, experience, projects, skills and full blog text.
